name: Dr Martyna Glodowska
bio: An established researcher with extensive scientific expertise and a strong international network across academia and industry. She connects knowledge from different fields and translates scientific insight into innovative applications and process concepts, shaping BioXtract's technology and research strategy.

name: Pieter van der Velden
bio: A driven and well-organized leader with a background in biochemistry, currently completing his PhD. He combines scientific expertise with clear communication and a strong vision for the company, leading BioXtract's development and commercialization efforts.

name: Dr Jessica Venetz
bio: She gained a PhD at the intersection of multiple disciplines, giving her the ability to bridge scientific, technical and operational domains. A creative problem-solver who aligns stakeholders and drives the company's day-to-day operations and growth.

name: Dr Suzanne Haaijer-Vroomen
bio: An experienced researcher with extensive practical expertise in laboratory operations and experimental development. She oversees laboratory organization, coordinates procurement and resource management, and trains new team members in methods and procedures.

name: Dr Stian Torset
bio: A dedicated researcher with expertise in bioprospecting and the discovery of novel metabolic pathways. He identifies biological opportunities and translates fundamental discoveries into practical solutions for the company.

name: Gabriela Mista
bio: A careful and dedicated PhD researcher central to the execution and validation of experimental work. Rigorous attention to detail generates the reliable, reproducible data behind BioXtract's technology development.

name: Daniel Wuehtrich
bio: A hands-on student research assistant with a background in process engineering. He supports R&D through laboratory experiments and practical research tasks, bringing an engineering perspective to process optimization and scale-up.

name: Mansour Gilasgar
bio: With a background in economics, he leads market research and commercial validation. He turns complex market intelligence into clear, actionable visualizations, bridging business strategy and technology development.

name: Dr Francisco Arjona Madueño
bio: Brings extensive experience in knowledge transfer and innovation commercialization, connecting academic research with real-world applications and providing guidance throughout the spinout process.

name: Dr Annabel van Driel
bio: A supportive project manager who advances the venture through effective coordination and stakeholder engagement, aligning the interests of different parties and keeping innovation activities moving forward.

name: Dr James M. Byrne
bio: An expert in environmental mineralogy and geomicrobiology, especially iron biomineralization and the redox cycling of Fe(II)- and Fe(III)-bearing minerals. He has published on metal recovery using biominerals and specializes in Mössbauer spectroscopy.

name: Dr Bonnie McDevitt
bio: Combines expertise in waste stream characterization, isotopic geochemistry and trace element recovery, providing strong applied experience for real-world recovery scenarios.

name: Dr Anna Potysz
bio: Brings extensive experience in geochemistry and microbial influences on metal-bearing rocks, mining slags and metal redox transformations, critical for understanding diverse waste matrices.

name: Dr Jeremiah Shuster
bio: Focuses on microbial-metal interactions in natural and engineered settings, strengthening the project's microbiological and ecological dimensions.

name: Dr Lucian Staicu
affiliation: BGR (Federal Institute for Geosciences and Natural Resources)
bio: An expert in the anaerobic respiration of metalloid contaminants and biomineralization, particularly for elements such as arsenic and selenium, aligning closely with critical raw material recovery objectives.

name: Dr Elizabeth J. Tomaszewski
bio: Specializes in geochemical transformations and spectroscopy, essential for a precise mechanistic understanding of metal redox behavior and elemental speciation in complex matrices.

name: Prof. Dr Henning Prommer
bio: A leader in reactive transport modeling, integrating chemical, biological and physical processes to predict metal mobility and guide process optimization. Co-founder of Ekion, which commercializes electrokinetic in-situ recovery (EK-ISR) of metals, including REEs.

name: Prof. Dr Mario Zarroca Hernandez
bio: Specializes in environmental geology and hydrogeology, focusing on metal recovery and remediation of mining wastes, including acid mine drainage treatment. With 25 years of consulting experience and over 50 scientific papers, he bridges research and applied environmental innovation.
